verdict.rationale: monday.com documents a GraphQL API (monday-docs-35). A typed GraphQL schema is the usual machine-readable equivalent of an OpenAPI spec, but no evidence shows a downloadable schema file, SDL export or introspection endpoint. The llms.txt probe also returned 404, so no other machine-readable descriptor is evidenced. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented downloadable spec or schema (OpenAPI/GraphQL SDL), documentation of introspection access, and independent corroboration.
